role: The stitched block atlas (terrain, textureType 0) and item atlas (textureType 1): registers every block and item icon, loads each sprite's PNG frames and animation metadata, stitches them with Stitcher, uploads the atlas and re-uploads animated sprites each tick.

members.name: locationBlocksTexture, locationItemsTexture
members.note: the build takes the stitched atlas from the oracle (MeshScene's atlas.json: each sprite's name, origin, size, rotation and minU/maxU/minV/maxV as raw float bits; atlas.rgba), read by rb_atlas_load: this member's result is Java's own, bit for bit, and the native has no stitcher

notes: The icon registration order matters for the atlas layout, which is why native reads the layout from the oracle's dump instead of recomputing it. registerIcons' item half drives every Item.registerIcons call in the game, including the ones the native mesher resolves by name from atlas.json (csrc/engine/render_blocks_int.h). lane/idxclient: the stitch and upload are closed as data (the oracle's dumped atlases, read bit for bit); the clock and compass sprites and the animations are texanim.c's.
